map.当你拿到一份以 rem 为单位的标注或设计稿，需要换算成 px 落地到固定尺寸场: Convert rem values from a spec or design file back to pixels using the current root font size for fixed-size contexts.
map.📖 查看「Rem to Px Converter使用指南」: 📖 View "Rem to Px Converter User Guide"
map.px = rem × root（root 为当前根元素 font-size）: px = rem × root (root is the current root element's font-size)
map.把以 rem 为单位的标注或设计稿按当前根字号反算为像素，用于需要固定尺寸的场景: Convert rem-based annotations or design drafts back to pixels using the current root font size, for fixed-size scenarios or checking annotations with designers.
map.px = rem × 根字号；根字号改变时同一 rem 对应的 px 会整体变化: px = rem × root font size; when the root size changes, the px for the same rem changes overall.
map.固定尺寸场景（如海报、原生 App 内嵌 WebView）常用 px；自适应网页: Fixed-size scenarios (e.g. posters, native App embedded WebView) commonly use px; responsive web pages recommend rem.
map.结果四舍五入到 2 位小数。: Results are rounded to 2 decimal places.
map.若采用 62.5% 根字号方案（1rem=10px），上表 px 值 = rem: If using the 62.5% root scheme (1rem = 10px), the px values above = rem × 10, e.g. 1.6rem → 16px, 2.4rem → 24px.
map.多数默认 16px，用户可改；以实际根字号折算。: Most default to 16px and users can change it; convert based on the actual root size.
map.调试时常用 px 核对真实渲染尺寸，便于与设计稿逐像素对齐。: During debugging px is commonly used to check the real rendered size, making it easy to align pixel-by-pixel with the design draft.

map.rem 是相对根元素（html）字体大小的单位：px=rem×根字号。浏览器默认: rem is a unit relative to the root element (html) font size: px = rem × root font size. The browser default root font size is 16px, so 1rem = 16px.
map.使用 rem 可实现整体缩放的无障碍友好布局；用户调整默认字号时 rem 布局同: Using rem enables an accessibility-friendly layout that scales as a whole; when the user changes the default font size the rem layout scales accordingly, while px stays fixed.
